\section[(dialogue)]{The house and things you carry — a first pass}

\label{lesson:PT-R103-first-pass-the-house-and-things-you-carry}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a scarf and boots.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a rug, a television, a computer, a fridge, an oven
  \item a shower, a bathtub, a shelf, a curtain, a blanket
  \item a towel, a bar of soap, a toothbrush, toothpaste, a comb
  \item rubbish, a broom, a washing machine, a sofa, a cupboard
  \item a pot, a frying pan, a bucket, a rope, a nail
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A rug? (\textbf{o tapete}.) A television? (\textbf{a televisão}.) A computer? (\textbf{o computador}.) A fridge? (\textbf{o frigorífico}.) An oven? (\textbf{o forno}.) A shower? (\textbf{o duche}.) A bathtub? (\textbf{a banheira}.) A shelf? (\textbf{a prateleira}.) A curtain? (\textbf{a cortina}.) A blanket? (\textbf{o cobertor}.) A towel? (\textbf{a toalha}.) A bar of soap? (\textbf{o sabonete}.) A toothbrush? (\textbf{a escova de dentes}.) Toothpaste? (\textbf{a pasta de dentes}.) A comb? (\textbf{o pente}.) Rubbish? (\textbf{o lixo}.) A broom? (\textbf{a vassoura}.) A washing machine? (\textbf{a máquina de lavar}.) A sofa? (\textbf{o sofá}.) A cupboard? (\textbf{o armário}.) A pot? (\textbf{a panela}.) A frying pan? (\textbf{a frigideira}.) A bucket? (\textbf{o balde}.) A rope? (\textbf{a corda}.) A nail? (\textbf{o prego}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

A hammer? (\textbf{o martelo}.) Glue? (\textbf{a cola}.) Scissors? (\textbf{a tesoura}.) A lamp? (\textbf{o candeeiro}.) A bathroom? (\textbf{a casa de banho}.) A cup? (\textbf{a chávena}.) A bottle? (\textbf{a garrafa}.) A letterbox? (\textbf{a caixa de correio}.) Pasta; dough? (\textbf{a massa}.) A pear? (\textbf{a pera}.) An alarm clock? (\textbf{o despertador}.) A mobile phone? (\textbf{o telemóvel}.) A stamp? (\textbf{o selo}.) A wallet? (\textbf{a carteira}.) A ring? (\textbf{o anel}.) A necklace? (\textbf{o colar}.) A photograph? (\textbf{a fotografia}.) A candle? (\textbf{a vela}.) A calendar? (\textbf{o calendário}.) A message? (\textbf{a mensagem}.) A rucksack? (\textbf{a mochila}.) The world? (\textbf{o mundo}.) People? (\textbf{as pessoas}.) A boy? (\textbf{o rapaz}.) A rainbow? (\textbf{o arco-íris}.) A jumper? (\textbf{a camisola}.) A tie? (\textbf{a gravata}.) Gloves? (\textbf{as luvas}.) A scarf? (\textbf{o cachecol}.) Boots?
